en.headline: ICAC graft complaints rise 40 percent, led by building repairs
en.dek: The graft-buster received 1,530 corruption complaints in the first eight months, with building management and maintenance reports more than doubling after the Tai Po Wang Fuk Court fire.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption received 1,530 suspected corruption complaints in the first eight months of 2026, about 40 percent more than in the same period last year, Commissioner Woo Ying-ming told the Legislative Council Security Panel.

The rise was driven by building management and maintenance cases, which climbed 113 percent to 558 from 262 a year earlier. The ICAC said public vigilance increased after last year’s five-alarm fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po. Pursuable complaints overall rose 51 percent to 1,317.

In the same eight months the commission prosecuted 122 people in 58 cases, similar to a year earlier. The conviction rate was 76 percent by number of persons and 79 percent by number of cases. Investigators assigned to building-repair files have been doubled to nearly 100, and more than 70 people were arrested in operations across estates citywide.

A special team set up after the Wang Fuk Court fire charged seven people and two companies in June with 20 offences including conspiracy to defraud, money laundering, attempting to pervert the course of public justice and tax evasion. Police separately charged three of those people and the two companies with five counts of manslaughter. Woo said other complaints would still be handled, though waiting times might lengthen if caseloads stay high.

zh.headline: 廉署首8月貪污投訴升四成 樓宇維修舉報倍增
zh.dek: 廉政專員胡英明向立法會表示，今年首8個月接獲1530宗懸疑貪污投訴，樓宇管理及維修舉報按年升113%，與大埔宏福苑大火後公眾警覺上升有關。
body: 廉政公署今年首8個月接獲1530宗懸疑貪污投訴，較去年同期增加約四成。廉政專員胡英明向立法會保安事務委員會簡報時表示，升幅主要由樓宇管理及維修類投訴帶動。
該類投訴由去年同期262宗升至558宗，升幅113%。廉署指，大埔宏福苑五級大火後，市民對維修工程貪污的警覺明顯提高。可追查投訴同期增加51%至1317宗。
同期廉署在58宗案件中檮控122人，人數與去年相若；定罪率以人數計為76%，以案件計為79%。署方已將專責調查大廈維修的人手倍增至近100人，首8個月在全港多個屋苑採取行動，拘捕逾70人。
宏福苑大火後成立的專案小組，已於6月起67人及兩間公司合共20項控罪，包括串謀詐騙、洗黑錢、企圖妨礙司法公正及逃稅。警方另就同一事件起訴當中3人及兩間公司合共5項誤殺罪。胡英明表示，其他投訴仍會處理，但若案件持續增多，處理時間或會較長。
